answer.text: No, the two fork oil quantities are not the same.
The right (RH) fork takes 589 ml, plus or minus 2.5 ml.
The left (LH) fork takes 507 ml, plus or minus 2.5 ml.
The manual says these values are approximate and the actual amount will vary.

policy.text: The fork oil capacities are approximate and the actual amount will vary.

disclaimers.text: The manual lists different fork oil quantities for the two forks, so confirm them with an authorised Royal Enfield service centre.

watchout_review.reason: The caution is about using the wrong engine oil grade, not fork oil quantity.
